# Build How-To: Bloodstained Pistols & Heavy Weapons (Energy Weapons & Critical Hits)

![](/uploads/ajaxGallery_78_nukaknights-post-build-pistols-heavies-crit.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

This build specializes in automatic **pistols** (can also be played with single-shot pistols) and **heavy energy weapons** that are suitable for **sneak** and **critical hits**. This build plays Bloodstained to take advantage of the many advantages of the Unyielding stats. This build benefits from the “Herbivore” mutation, especially in AP acceleration. The theme for this character is also the **Brotherhood of Steel**, so the focus is on energy weapons and the character uses **Brotherhood Recon Armor**. Of course, this is a matter of taste and not essential to the build itself.

![](/uploads/nukaknights-build-pistols-heavies-crit-skywalka55-fallout76-20230321-21-42-15.jpg)

## Equipment

![](/uploads/nukaknights-build-pistols-heavies-crit-skywalka55-fallout76-20230321-20-20-35.jpg) 

One of the primary heavy weapons is the **Plasma Launcher**. Many people confuse the plasma rifle/pistol with a flamethrower barrel with the plasma thrower because the name is similar. However, the plasma thrower is a completely different weapon that offers completely different advantages. The Plasma Thrower is a heavy sniper weapon that can be played while sneaking and is good at scoring critical hits. The range is good and the precision is also good in most cases. In some cases the plasma thrower doesn't hit well in VATS, here I'm not sure if this is a VATS bug or if it's e.g. may be related to server overload in certain locations. However, the plasma thrower is very suitable for this build. The damage from both normal and critical hits is more than good, as you can see in the gameplay videos below.

![](/uploads/nukaknights-build-pistols-heavies-crit-skywalka55-fallout76-20230322-07-49-33.jpg) 

The **flamethrower** is also very good for critical hits and is also not loud, so it can be used while sneaking. The range is of course limited, so you have to decide when to use it depending on the situation. However, the flamethrower is very suitable in tight spaces or in daily operations with invisible enemies. Or of course when you are standing in front of a group of opponents and want to catch as many of them as possible. There is also a video of this below.

![](/uploads/nukaknights-build-pistols-heavies-crit-skywalka55-fallout76-20230321-20-37-02.jpg) 

I was very lucky with this **Enclave Plasma Pistol**. As you know from our article Everything about the Enclave Plasma Rifle / Pistol and Mods, a reflex sight is particularly important. This version has a reflex sight and an automatic barrel, so it falls into the "guerrilla" category for automatic pistols. The damage, range and precision are extremely good. The only disadvantage is the high AP consumption. Here you can e.g. help out in boss fights with canned coffee. You can also see a gameplay video of this below.

![](/uploads/nukaknights-build-pistols-heavies-crit-skywalka55-fallout76-20230321-21-26-48.jpg) 

The **10mm pistol** is the all-round / everyday weapon for pistol builds and can be played in many situations. I mainly use them outside of boss fights. This build always carries a Q2515cf and a B50crit15cf 10mm automatic pistol with him.

**Alternatives:** Other automatic pistols e.g. Laser pistol and improvised pistol are of course also playable. If you prefer to play single-shot pistols, that is of course also possible. Here, of course, the gunslinger has to be used instead of guerrilla under agility.
